patthana22.12:1.1: Nakusalaṃ napariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato pariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Naakusalaṃ napariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato pariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Naabyākataṃ napariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato pariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā pañca.
patthana22.12:2.1: Nakusalaṃ naapariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo apariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nakusalaṃ naapariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato apariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Dve. (Akusalamūle dve, dukamūle dve.)… Hetuyā cha.
